body: observation-watcher runReportFooter(): adds 'git pull --rebase origin main' between commit and push. On rebase conflict: escalation Apple + skip push (no force). emily-agent main.go ConversationStore.Save(): pull-rebase before push, escalates to IDUNA on conflict and skips push. Implements The Emily Way distributed git discipline.
title: S44-05: git pull --rebase before push in obs-watcher + emily-agent ConversationStore
